description: We are RETAL SPACE EXPLORERS, a family innovation team from Bahrain led by 10-year-old Retal, alongside her sisters Aseel and Basant, supported by our parents. We love coding, AI, game development, and space exploration. Our goal is to create an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer that makes space science fun and accessible to children. We welcome collaboration in space science, research, and simulation design. Together, we dream, learn, explore, and innovate!
summary:
**RETAL SPACE LAB — Junior Astronaut Training Academy**

RETAL SPACE LAB is an interactive educational platform developed by RETAL SPACE EXPLORERS to transform space science into an engaging learning experience for children. Through a simulated lunar exploration environment, students take on the role of junior astronauts, completing missions and solving challenges related to energy management, oxygen supply, water conservation, food production, robotics, and lunar survival.

The platform combines interactive space missions, educational games, illustrated stories, scientific videos, experiments, and an intelligent virtual assistant, NOVA, to guide learners in Arabic and English. A motivational system of stars, rewards, and achievements encourages exploration and continuous learning.

Its flexible design allows new games, stories, videos, and missions to be added and updated over time, creating an expanding educational universe.

The project addresses the challenge by allowing children to experience astronaut responsibilities, make decisions, explore scientific concepts, and learn through experimentation rather than passive reading. Its goal is to develop critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and interest in STEM and future space exploration.
details:
RETAL SPACE LAB — Project Details

1. What does the project do and how does it work?

RETAL SPACE LAB is an interactive Junior Astronaut Training Academy designed to help children explore space science through hands-on learning, simulation, and problem-solving.

The platform places students in the role of junior astronauts responsible for operating and maintaining a simulated lunar base. They face realistic educational challenges involving oxygen supply, energy management, water conservation, food production, radiation protection, and emergency response.

Students complete progressive space missions, make decisions, observe their consequences, conduct scientific experiments, and learn from their results. The platform also includes educational games, interactive stories, science videos, learning paths, achievements, and digital rewards.

An intelligent virtual assistant, NOVA, supports learners by explaining scientific concepts, providing hints, and guiding them through activities in both Arabic and English.

2. Benefits and Expected Impact

The project transforms complex space science concepts into engaging, accessible learning experiences for children.

Its expected benefits include:

  • Developing critical thinking and scientific reasoning.
  • Improving problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Introducing children to space engineering and resource management.
  • Encouraging creativity, curiosity, and independent learning.
  • Promoting collaboration and teamwork.
  • Making STEM education more accessible through interactive digital experiences.

Students can also have individual accounts to track their progress, completed missions, achievements, and learning activities.

3. Tools and Technologies

The platform is developed using OnSpace as the application development environment and OnSpace Cloud for centralized data storage and account management.

The project uses a web-based interactive interface designed for computers, tablets, and smartphones.

Its main technological components include:

  • Interactive simulation and decision-making systems.
  • Cloud-based accounts and progress management.
  • AI-assisted educational interaction through NOVA.
  • Multimedia integration for educational videos and illustrated stories.
  • Interactive game and reward systems.
  • Responsive web application and installable PWA capabilities.

The platform is designed to support Arabic and English, making it accessible to a wider range of young learners.

4. What makes the project innovative?

The main innovation is combining several educational experiences into one connected space exploration journey.

Instead of simply answering questions about space, children actively manage a simulated lunar base, make decisions, experience consequences, and apply scientific knowledge to solve problems.

Games, stories, videos, experiments, and missions are connected to create meaningful learning paths. NOVA acts as a virtual space mentor, helping students understand challenges and explore possible solutions.

The platform also provides opportunities for children to create and share their own educational games, stories, and scientific projects.

5. Factors Considered During Development

Our team considered several important factors:

  • Age-appropriate content and simple navigation for children.
  • Scientific accuracy supported by reliable educational references.
  • Realistic but simplified lunar mission scenarios.
  • Accessibility in Arabic and English.
  • Different learning abilities and difficulty levels.
  • Motivation through achievements and rewards.
  • Data organization and individual learning progress.
  • Compatibility with different devices.
  • Opportunities for schools, teachers, and educational institutions to participate.

6. Our Vision

RETAL SPACE LAB aims to make space exploration an accessible learning experience for every curious child.

We believe that young learners should not only read about astronauts and space missions, but also experience the challenges, make decisions, experiment, and discover solutions themselves.

Our mission: Learn. Explore. Experiment. Survive.

Developed by RETAL SPACE EXPLORERS.
